title: Stop juggling PDF tools and get PDF Expert Premium for just $79.99 this Black Friday
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: You can pay $79.99 (reg. $139.99) once to edit, sign, merge, and convert PDFs on your Mac with PDF Expert during this Black Friday sale.

A PDF is easy enough to open. Though things get interesting when you need to fix a typo, sign the last page, and send back just that page before lunch. PDF Expert’s Premium Plan for Mac is only $79.99 for Black Friday (reg. $139.99). The deal gives new users lifetime access for one payment.

Say you spot the wrong date on a flyer after it’s already been saved as a PDF. You can fix the text right in the file. The same goes for swapping in an updated logo or adding a link. When you’re reviewing someone else’s draft, you can highlight a sentence and leave a comment right where it belongs.

Fill out and sign a school form on your Mac, then merge it with its attachments so you can send one file. Need to share just one page from a longer document? Pull it out and save it as a separate PDF.

There’s even a way to find a line in an old scan. PDF Expert can recognize the text so you can search it, highlight it, or copy it. For anyone who regularly gets stuck doing more than reading a PDF, that’s a lot of use out of a one-time purchase.

Get a lifetime of PDF Expert’s Premium Plan for Mac for only $79.99 for Black Friday (reg. $139.99).
